summary: Extensive diffuse bilateral hazy/reticular opacities present on prior have substantially cleared on current, with lungs now appearing much better aerated.

findings.rationale: Prior shows marked diffuse bilateral haziness/reticular opacification obscuring vascular markings throughout both lungs; current shows clearly visible bronchovascular markings with much reduced background haze, consistent with improved pulmonary edema/congestion. Caveat: differing patient rotation and support-device positions limit precise comparison.
